title: Little-kid orbit
summary: The household will probably revolve around routines, transitions, and tiny emotional weather systems.
expect: Small choices around sleep, meals, and patience can create outsized calm.
focus: Protect predictable rituals and leave extra space for messy recovery days.

title: Teen launchpad
summary: Independence, identity, and schedule negotiations are likely to become the loudest family themes.
expect: Trust-building choices will matter more than perfect control.
focus: Offer structure, listen before solving, and keep low-pressure connection on the calendar.

title: Midlife balancing act
summary: Your family may ask you to balance work momentum, long-term money choices, and care for more than one generation.
expect: Boundaries and planned rest will be as strategic as ambition.
focus: Spend attention like a limited resource: deliberately, visibly, and before burnout invoices arrive.
